observedSpokenEnglishFamily.methodology: Queries matching spoken English / English speaking / conversational English / English conversation / speak English / speaking English, then split into generic non-location, explicit Hyderabad, and near-me subsets. Mixed phonics, jobs and free-practice queries were excluded from the generic subset.

allThreeSubsets.note: Near-me visibility on the Hyderabad page is treated as local discovery/support, not authority to become the canonical Spoken-English programme owner.

explicitHyderabad.interpretation: Subject-qualified Hyderabad Spoken-English intent is leakage under the Brick 2 ownership contract; the Hyderabad page remains a broad local English chooser.

nearMe.interpretation: Localized discovery signal. Preserve the local chooser while strengthening the handoff to the subject owner; do not create near-me or city-specific Spoken-English pages.
